paras: Rabdion forsteni, also known commonly as Forsten's pointed snake, is a species of snake in the family Colubridae. The species is native to a part of Indonesia.
The specific name, forsteni, is in honor of Dutch naturalist Eltio Alegondas Forsten.
R. forsteni is endemic to the island of Sulawesi (formerly called Celebes) in  Indonesia.
The preferred natural habitat of R. forsteni is forest, at altitudes up to 1,830 m (6,000 ft).
